messages.subject: Datalogging During Aerial/Shipboard Surveys
parts:
Hello Distance-Samplers,

Who on this planet is using existing Datalogging/DAQ technology to log
data
from digital inclinometers (sighting angles to animals), aircraft/ship
attitude sensors (either built-in electronics or stand alone attitude
sensing units), and weather sensors (light, temperature) during transect
surveys? I'm particularly interested in whether anyone is logging this
data for use in determining sightability conditions and distance from the
sighting platform.

A related question, is anyone using aerial/shipboard videography of the
transect belt and beyond to record imagery of animal habitat during
transect surveys?

Any contact information (email, website, phone number, mailing address)
would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,

Ted Elliott
